title: symphyotrichum trilineatum
intro: Symphyotrichum trilineatum, commonly known as the three-flowered aster, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is valued for its health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, as well as its potential to aid in reducing stress and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of Symphyotrichum trilineatum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, making it a promising natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
